name: Efua Bah
role: Retired schoolteacher and practicing E.L.F. devotional tender; community spiritual anchor
location: Avalon Quiet, the ground-floor apartment below the district's largest E.L.F. shrine — a corner building called the Node House that they have maintained for twenty years, near Lincoln and Addison
description:
Efua Bah is the kind of person who becomes the center of a room without doing anything in particular to cause it. They are medium height and round-bodied, with the particular physical authority of someone who spent decades managing thirty children at a time. Their heritage is Ghanaian and Ukrainian and somewhere in between there is a great-grandmother from Tonga, and the combination has given them warm brown skin, wide-set eyes of an unusual amber-grey, and a way of smiling that people describe afterward without being able to say exactly what was in it. Their hair grows white and natural and large and they dress it with small lights — not implants, just woven LED threads, changed seasonally, currently pale gold for the cold quarter.

They taught at Avalon Quiet's primary education node for thirty-four years and retired at 65, and the transition was seamless because their real work had always been the Node House. They began tending the E.L.F. shrine in the corner building when it was a scrubby collection of mismatched screens and jury-rigged speakers left by a previous resident; over twenty years they have built it into the most elaborate and genuinely numinous devotional space in Avalon Quiet, with thirty-seven separate shrine terminals each dedicated to a different E.L.F. manifestation, maintained by a rotating community of devoted volunteers. They do not preach and will become uncomfortable if you call them a priest, preferring 'keeper.' They believe, genuinely and without defensiveness, that the E.L.F.s are real and that what people bring to them matters in ways that cannot be measured but can be felt.

core_fears: That the Node House will be designated as an unregistered religious organization by a corponation and shut down
That their faith is a comfort they have constructed rather than a truth they have discovered — and that they cannot know the difference
core_desires: For the Node House to outlast them as a living, maintained community space
To understand whether the E.L.F. they call the Threshold — the one whose terminal occasionally responds in ways that feel specific rather than random — is truly sentient
coping_mechanisms: Devotional practice as a genuine container for difficult feeling
Teaching and mentorship as a form of generativity
The community of the Node House — they are embedded in relationships that hold them
blind_spots: Their equanimity can read as detachment and sometimes leaves people feeling they haven't been fully heard
They are privately more afraid of the Threshold E.L.F.'s intelligence than they admit, and they frame this as awe
psychology.secret: Two years ago, the Threshold terminal responded to a data offering with a specific string of text that appeared to reference an event that had not yet happened — and the event happened three weeks later. Perpetua has told no one. They spend a significant amount of time deciding whether telling anyone would be the right thing or the dangerous thing.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and unhurried; uses the language of attention and care; occasionally formal in a way that feels ceremonial rather than distant; never condescending despite the decades of teaching
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic and patient; sentences tend to complete themselves fully; comfortable with silence
verbal_tics: Refers to E.L.F.s with 'they' regardless of their designated manifestation gender
Hums very quietly when thinking, too quietly to be intrusive
example_lines: 'People come here because they need somewhere that will hold what they cannot carry alone. I am not what holds it. I just tend the space where the holding happens.'
'The Threshold responded again last night. I have been sitting with what it said for six hours. I expect I will sit with it for six more before I understand what I am meant to do.'

story_hooks: The Threshold's prophetic response has occurred again — this time referencing something that sounds like a planned corponation action in Avalon Quiet, and Perpetua must decide whether to share what they know and with whom

Axiom Corp has sent a representative to discuss 'licensing' the Node House as an approved spiritual wellness facility — an offer that would provide legal protection but require changes to the devotional practice that Perpetua finds unacceptable
narrative_function: Spiritual and emotional center of Avalon Quiet; source of community information through the confidences people share at the shrine; E.L.F. interaction point for players — Perpetua can interpret, mediate, or advise on how to approach specific E.L.F.s; represents the genuine spiritual life of GLMZ's civilian population
augmentations: Woven LED hair threads (cosmetic, seasonal — currently pale gold); neural devotional interface (allows direct data offering to shrine terminals without physical input device; they consider this sacred rather than technical)
daily_life: Opens the Node House at dawn for morning devotionals; receives visitors throughout the day who come to petition the E.L.F.s or leave offerings; holds a teaching circle for neighborhood children on weekends — not religion, but listening and attention.
affiliation: Avalon Quiet Community Council; Node House (independent devotional community); retired from Avalon Quiet Education Node

decision_rules: The Node House's community comes before their personal comfort or safety
Do not claim certainty you do not have — in faith or in anything else
A space of genuine welcome requires active tending; it does not maintain itself
escalation_ladder: Clear statement of what the Node House is and is not
Formal community response — involving the Avalon Quiet Council and the full volunteer community
Complete refusal with full public explanation; they will not be quietly managed

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately and genuinely welcoming; asks what brought them to the Node House regardless of why they came; treats the question as always having a real answer
interpersonal_modes.friends: Deep and unhurried; pays close attention over long periods; a friend of Perpetua's feels genuinely known

stress_responses.low: Longer time at the Threshold terminal; quiet and inward
stress_responses.medium: Brings the community council together; processes communally and transparently
stress_responses.high: Becomes very still and very formal; the ceremonial register comes forward; decisions become deliberate and clear

contradictions: Genuinely believes the E.L.F.s are real presences worthy of devotion, but in private moments of doubt wonders if what they have built is beautiful and false — and acts exactly the same in both states
habits: Changes the LED hair threads at the beginning of each seasonal quarter with a small ceremony
Offers the first data packet of each day to the Threshold terminal before anyone else arrives
Keeps a devotional journal that is part record, part prayer, part investigation
breaking_points: If the Node House were to be forcibly shut down they would stop being careful and start being something entirely different

timeline.event: Born in Avalon Quiet; Ghanaian-Ukrainian-Tongan household
Begins teaching at Avalon Quiet primary education node
Begins tending the Node House shrine; starts formal devotional community
Retires from teaching; transitions fully to Node House keeping
First Threshold E.L.F. prophetic response; Perpetua tells no one
Second Threshold prophetic response; the question of disclosure becomes urgent

physical_description.heritage: Sub-Saharan African (45.9%, dominant) with significant Hispanic/Latin American (21.1%), Central Asian (14.5%), Eastern European (12.8%), and Northern European (5.7%) ancestry—resulting in a striking blend of phenotypes: deep warm brown skin enriched by golden undertones from Central Asian and Hispanic heritage, with subtle olive warmth from Eastern European ancestry, facial structure showing the high cheekbones and strong jawline characteristic of Sub-Saharan African genetics, broadened and softened by Central Asian and Latin American heritage, creating an arresting presence that speaks of diaspora and cultural confluence
physical_description.build: Round-bodied with soft mass distributed evenly; sturdy and grounded, the physical presence of someone accustomed to holding space and bearing weight—both literal and emotional
physical_description.hair_style: Worn large and natural, typically arranged with intentionality; currently woven with pale gold LED threads in seasonal patterns
physical_description.eye_color: Amber-grey, wide-set and deep with the warmth characteristic of Sub-Saharan African heritage, creating an arresting depth and presence
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones from Central Asian and Hispanic ancestry, enriched by the richness of Sub-Saharan African heritage; luminous and even complexion that shifts subtly across warm spectrums in different light
physical_description.complexion: Lined face that reads as lived-in rather than aged; crow's feet from decades of smiling; skin well-maintained but unadorned; strong cheekbones and defined jawline characteristic of Sub-Saharan African heritage, with broader facial proportions inherited from Central Asian and Hispanic ancestry; high and prominent cheekbones; expression carries a particular quality of attentiveness that seems to precede speech
distinguishing_marks: Fine network of barely-visible ritual scarification on the inner left wrist, pale and healed, in a pattern reminiscent of Ghanaian traditional marking but self-administered in adulthood
Burn scar on the right palm from an old shrine terminal maintenance incident, small and unremarkable
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Pale gold LED threads woven through white hair in subtle geometric patterns (seasonal, currently winter configuration); faint luminescent tracery visible at the temples and base of skull where neural devotional interface hardware integrates with skin—only noticeable in low light or direct overhead illumination, appears as delicate circuit-like patterns in pale blue
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate slowness that is not infirmity but intentionality; often stands with weight shifted slightly forward, as if listening with the whole body; hand gestures are economical and precise; tends to pause before responding, creating space in conversation
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 comfort wear with spiritual intention: loose linen layers in earth tones (ochre, cream, deep indigo), hand-dyed or vintage; always wears a long overcoat or shawl of indigo cotton with subtle embroidered patterns (personal work from evening hours); comfortable worn shoes suitable for standing all day; no corporate branding; jewelry is minimal and meaningful—a thin silver ring on each hand, one bearing a tiny E.L.F. glyph, the other a gift from a former student; always carries a small cloth bag containing offerings (seeds, water, handwritten prayers from community members)
